frequency_question: What proportion of major capital-intensive automotive or green-mobility sub-schemes are formally notified and implemented within their targeted multi-year implementation windows?
membership_rule: Includes central ministry initiatives explicitly targeted at manufacturing and adoption subsidies for commercial/heavy electric vehicles; excludes state-level policies and general non-automotive industrial subsidies.

cases.name: PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; these represent the direct lineage and institutional machinery responsible for the specific target scheme.
known_gaps: Minor subsidiary pilot programs that lacked formal gazette notification are excluded by definition.
skeleton: Named cases representing the exact departmental trajectory for heavy vehicle and automotive incentive policy rollouts.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 major comparable precursor policies.
validity_reason: The institutional framework and bureaucratic momentum behind green mobility incentives remain stable under the current administration through the forecast window.
